note: The fonts of source.xlsx (one cell each, in this order) and what a server with only the shipped fonts shows each with (E3.13). Read by _build_fixtures.py to make the file, by spec.py, and by the tests of every place the stand-ins reach: claudia-fonts, the server's /api/fonts, typesetting and the layout library (print and PDF). stand_in is the family the catalogue gives for the font itself (null: neither the font nor a font with its widths, so the generic family's font is used); closeness is same, same-widths or other (claudia_fonts.CLOSENESS).
